title: Critical Cubic Crossover from Hermite Universality in Riemann-ξ Jensen Polynomials
author: Wanzheng Ning
journal: Journal of the London Mathematical Society
summary: A single-author manuscript on the critical cubic crossover from Hermite universality in Riemann xi-function Jensen polynomials. It was submitted to the Journal of the London Mathematical Society on 31 August 2026 and is currently under review.
accessText: The manuscript and private submission materials are not publicly available while the article is under review because the current submission agreement restricts public sharing.
